infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Daily Imaan needs your location to calculate accurate prayer times.

plugins._comment_sounds: To enable bundled Makkah / Madinah adhans in the prayer-time notification: 1) drop adhan-makkah.mp3 and adhan-madinah.mp3 into assets/sounds/ (see that folder's README.md for sourcing + licensing), then 2) replace the empty array below with ["./assets/sounds/adhan-makkah.mp3", "./assets/sounds/adhan-madinah.mp3"], then 3) rebuild with `eas build`. The in-app Adhan Sound picker (Settings) is already wired — when files are missing expo-notifications silently falls back to the device default sound.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Daily Imaan needs your location to calculate accurate prayer times.

plugins._comment: REQUIRED FOR APP STORE BUILDS — replace with your 10-character Apple Developer Team ID before running `eas build --profile production --platform ios`. Find it at https://developer.apple.com/account → Membership.
